priors.name: Batch 01: 13 owner payer-flow candidates (triage, controls, batch rule)
priors.verdict: Rejected: 0 of 13. 11 not testable here (no data for front/second futures, dividend or coupon calendars, option open interest, basis, KRW; several not tradeable on MT5 Prime). Tested 2 (8 configurations), both rejected at the lab gate: US close flow (US500/NAS100, last 15-30 min with the day's move): before costs about 0 in 2011-19 (-0.011 to +0.011R), net -0.03 to -0.05R, no better than small-move control days. Month-end rebalancing (4 indices, against the month's move): before costs and swaps +0.05 to +0.17R (t about 2) in 2011-19, swaps took it to about 0, and 2020-22 was negative even before costs (-0.05 to -0.22R). 2023-25 not opened.
